verification.installation_statement: Both published distribution formats passed all 81 tests in six new Windows environments with Python 3.10/3.12/3.14 and NumPy 2.2.6/2.3.5/2.5.4. The Python 3.12 environments reused base dependencies.
verification.remote_ci_statement: The version-tag workflow passed all 15 Linux/macOS/Windows and Python 3.10--3.14 jobs, each including the installed suite, 12 branch-summary tests and four verification-CLI tests. It also installed and tested the built wheel and source distribution.
verification.scope: Verified public tag workflow and six actual installations of its downloaded release assets; human verification remains documented by its dated record

publication_state: Final submission article; released software and separate fixed article sources
